title: Add ExactAlarmScheduler
description: Object owning scheduling/cancelling the single exact-alarm reminder per dose log, checking the API 31+ SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM permission before scheduling and no-oping (not falling back to WorkManager) when it isn't granted, since this app's MVP has no coarse fallback pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: object ExactAlarmScheduler with public const val EXTRA_DOSE_LOG_ID, EXTRA_TITLE, EXTRA_TEXT string constants (public, not private, so ReminderAlarmReceiver can reference them)
fun canScheduleExact(context: Context): Boolean returns true below API 31 (S), otherwise checks AlarmManager.canScheduleExactAlarms()

fun schedule(context: Context, doseLogId: Int, triggerAtMillis: Long, title: String, text: String) first calls cancel(context, doseLogId), then returns early if !canScheduleExact(context), otherwise calls AlarmManager.setExactAndAllowWhileIdle(AlarmManager.RTC_WAKEUP, triggerAtMillis, pendingIntent) targeting ReminderAlarmReceiver
fun cancel(context: Context, doseLogId: Int) cancels the alarm via AlarmManager.cancel and also calls NotificationHelper.cancel(context, doseLogId) to clear any already-posted notification

The PendingIntent targets ReminderAlarmReceiver, uses doseLogId as its request code, and carries doseLogId/title/text as intent extras under the EXTRA_* keys, built with FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or FLAG_IMMUTABLE
